current.service_desc: The Vanta Trust Management Platform provides customers with an end-to-end security and compliance automation suite that focuses on the following activities: continuous and automated governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), vendor risk management, questionnaire automation, and up-to-date security program description displayed on the customers' Trust Center website. In addition, Vanta works closely with customers and selected audit partners to help streamline compliance against security compliance frameworks such as System and Organization Controls (SOC) 2, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, ISO 42001, National Institute of Standards and Technology Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (NIST AI RMF), CIS CSC, NIST CSF, FedRAMP, and more. Vanta serves as a continuous monitoring solution to ensure organizations reach and maintain a state of security.

used_by.use: Vanta Trust Management Platform — continuous configuration monitoring of the production cloud accounts (read-only metadata), compliance evidence and policies, and the Specset Trust Center at trust.specset.com. Since 2026-10-29 its scanner holds, on the boundary project, custom roles with the permissions of Google's Security Reviewer role except those that list log entries, Data Access audit-log entries and bucket objects. Until then it held that role, which also let it read the boundary project's Data Access audit-log entries and list object names, both of which identify customer documents; whether Vanta read them is not known.
Vanta Trust Management Platform: continuous control monitoring, evidence collection and the Trust Center used to share FedRAMP Certification Data.

Collects compliance evidence through a read-only cross-account audit role. FedRAMP 20x Low, below the Moderate baseline. Compensating measures: the role requires an external ID, carries only read-only audit permissions, sessions last at most one hour, and CloudTrail records every call. It holds no customer data.
